requirements.label: Minor requirements (from LSA)
requirements.hint: Requirements Minimum Credits: 15 COMMON REQUIREMENTS FOR ALL PHILOSOPHY ACADEMIC MINORS:Any 100- or 200-level course other than PHIL 180, 183 (if elected after FA20), 201, 296 (logic courses).At least one course at the 400-level, other than formal methods (PHIL 413, 414)A minimum of 15 credits of Philosophy, at least 9 of which (including the required 400-level course) must be taken in residence.No course will count toward the minor unless the student receives a grade of C- or better.SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR Moral and Political Philosophy:One of PHIL 361 or 362 or 366 or 367 or PPE 300Three additional courses from: PHIL 353, 355, 356, 359, 361, 366, 367, 369, 384, 385, 429, 430, 431, 433, 441, 442, 443, 444, 446, 485 (one of which must be at the 400-level), PPE 300
